# eye4.cn
> Eye4.cn provides cloud-connected smart camera services, including mobile apps, device setup, support, and account access.

The site appears to center on Eye4 smart camera products and their companion services, with emphasis on app downloads, user support, and account-related access.

## Main Site
- [Home](https://www.eye4.cn/): Main landing page for Eye4 smart camera services and product ecosystem.
- [About](https://www.eye4.cn/about): Overview of the company and Eye4 platform background.
- [Contact](https://www.eye4.cn/contact): Contact information and support inquiry options for Eye4 users.
- [Support](https://www.eye4.cn/support): Central support entry point for help, troubleshooting, and service resources.

## Downloads
- [Download Center](https://www.eye4.cn/download): Official downloads for Eye4 mobile apps and related software.
- [Android App](https://www.eye4.cn/download/android): Android application download for managing Eye4 smart cameras.
- [iOS App](https://www.eye4.cn/download/ios): iPhone and iPad application download for Eye4 devices.
- [PC Client](https://www.eye4.cn/download/pc): Desktop client download for viewing and managing Eye4 cameras.
- [User Manuals](https://www.eye4.cn/download/manual): Downloadable manuals and setup documents for supported devices.

## Account
- [Login](https://www.eye4.cn/login): User sign-in page for accessing Eye4 account services.
- [Register](https://www.eye4.cn/register): Account creation page for new Eye4 users.
- [Forgot Password](https://www.eye4.cn/forgot-password): Password recovery workflow for existing Eye4 accounts.
- [Account Center](https://www.eye4.cn/account): Manage account settings, profile details, and connected services.

## Help Center
- [Help Center](https://www.eye4.cn/help): Knowledge base for common questions, setup, and troubleshooting.
- [Getting Started](https://www.eye4.cn/help/getting-started): Introductory setup guidance for first-time Eye4 users.
- [Device Setup](https://www.eye4.cn/help/device-setup): Instructions for connecting and configuring Eye4 cameras.
- [Network Troubleshooting](https://www.eye4.cn/help/network): Help for Wi‑Fi connection and network-related issues.
- [FAQ](https://www.eye4.cn/help/faq): Frequently asked questions about Eye4 apps, devices, and services.

## Device Management
- [Add Device](https://www.eye4.cn/device/add): Steps for adding a new camera to an Eye4 account.
- [Device List](https://www.eye4.cn/device): Overview of connected devices and management options.
- [Firmware Upgrade](https://www.eye4.cn/device/firmware): Firmware update information and upgrade guidance for devices.
- [Reset Device](https://www.eye4.cn/device/reset): Instructions for resetting Eye4 cameras to factory defaults.
- [Sharing Devices](https://www.eye4.cn/device/share): Guidance for sharing camera access with family or other users.

## Cloud Services
- [Cloud Service](https://www.eye4.cn/cloud): Overview of cloud storage and related Eye4 service features.
- [Cloud Plans](https://www.eye4.cn/cloud/plans): Subscription options and plan details for cloud recording services.
- [Playback](https://www.eye4.cn/cloud/playback): Access and review recorded cloud video footage.
- [Event Recording](https://www.eye4.cn/cloud/events): Information about motion events and cloud event capture.
- [Subscription Management](https://www.eye4.cn/cloud/subscription): Manage billing and active cloud service subscriptions.

## News and Updates
- [News](https://www.eye4.cn/news): Company announcements, service updates, and product-related news.
- [App Updates](https://www.eye4.cn/news/app-updates): Release information and changes for Eye4 mobile applications.
- [Firmware News](https://www.eye4.cn/news/firmware): Announcements about firmware improvements and device updates.
- [Service Notices](https://www.eye4.cn/news/notices): Operational notices, maintenance alerts, and service advisories.

## Policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.eye4.cn/privacy): Privacy practices governing Eye4 websites, apps, and services.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.eye4.cn/terms): Terms and conditions for using Eye4 products and services.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.eye4.cn/cookies): Information about cookie usage and related preferences.
- [Data Protection](https://www.eye4.cn/data-protection): Details on data handling, security, and compliance practices.
